newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Finance Ministry to oversee precious metals.
newsitem.headline: Russia Finance Ministry to oversee precious metals.

text.p: The Russian government has signed a decree giving the Finance Ministry responsibility for the precious metals and stones sector, Interfax news agency said on Monday.
It said the decree, which has not yet been officially published, had also created a special directorate at the ministry called Goskhran Rossii to store and dispose of precious metals and stones.
The ministry has effectively taken over the role of the defunct State Committee for Precious Metals and Stones, the government agency disbanded by presidential decree last August.

Intefax said Goskhran would be responsible for operations with precious metals and stones from strategic state reserves and will store and independently conduct operations with materials, including stocking and destocking the reserves. --Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
